assumptions.te_min_load_source: Havells Apogee ATADEXB102 states a 60 W minimum (ff3336cd product screen, 17 Nov 2026) and is excluded for these sub-60 W groups. Later ff3336cd research (binding\low-load-dimmer-options.md, 18 Nov 2026, SHA-256 cfb01ab85ba6774de09f99fd3b17774dbdfefc7253457cf9737a181c7d84f8b4) found India-listed low-load LED-dimmer candidates: Legrand Lyncus 677304 (LED 3-50 W; India e-shop), Legrand Arteor AA24107MB (LED 7-200 VA; India e-shop; +5 to +35 C usage) and Schneider AvatarOn E8331RD250_WE (LED 3-100 VA; India catalogue; local supply unverified). These are candidate controls only: no exact fitting + driver + dimmer chain is documented or sample-tested, so compatibility is unproven and all 10 mains-dimmer procurement holds remain.
